name: stefancordery
description: Stefan Cordery's skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: stefancordery-skills
plugins.description: Skills for Claude, each built so you can check its work. find-events finds events worth attending, checked against the organiser's own page. check-call-summary checks an AI call summary against the transcript before it goes in your CRM. check-account-list checks every company on a target account list, with evidence, before you spend on it. check-claims traces every fact in a draft to whoever first published it, before you publish or send it.
